heading: It asks first.

said.line: Shut down the PC? Turn for yes.

body: Anything drastic waits for a yes on the puck itself: turn it to Yes, then tap. The Windows PC is one more thing it can run, from its volume and headphones to its apps and its power.
house: The puck is turned, and tapped. The study’s screen goes dark.

faces.name: confirm-yes
faces.alt: The puck's Confirm face: “Shut down or restart this PC?”, with Yes picked in green.

still.name: pc
still.alt: The card house at night, the study upstairs on the right now dark.
